user.title: Blinds Configuration
user.description: Configure time-based control for your blinds.

data.tilt_open: Tilt time to OPEN (seconds, 0 to disable)
data.tilt_closed: Tilt time to CLOSE (seconds, 0 to disable)
data.send_stop_at_end: Send STOP command when target position reached

data_description.dead_time: Delay before the motor relay actually engages (default 0.78s). Added to commanded movements so effective travel time is exact.
data_description.stop_delay: Time the motor coasts after the relay turns off before coming to a stop (default 0.15s). Subtracted from relay run time.
data_description.sperrzeit: Lockout threshold (default 0.2s). Commands <= this threshold are blocked by HA to prevent triggering unwanted full-travel pulses. Physical button presses <= this trigger full travel.
data_description.overtravel_time: Extra run time on 0% and 100% to ensure physical limit switches are reached and eliminate drift.
data_description.interlock_delay: Safety pause between switching from up to down (or down to up) to protect relays and motor.

error.no_switches: No switch entities found. Please ensure switch entities exist before setting up.
